subject: Question: EOD rollover, backfill events, and SOC 2 coverage timestamps
messages:
From: Olivia Park <audit@omniassurance.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: ops-security@nimbus-analytics.com
Date: Fri, 25 Sep 2026 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: SOC 2: EOD rollover / backfill handling question

Hi Mateo,

We're preparing the Type II procedures for Nimbus Analytics and need a quick clarification on Redwood's interpretation of the 'end of day' (EOD) cutoff for point-in-time evidence. Specifically:

- If an event occurred at 23:58 (user timestamp) but ingestion/processing completed at 00:06 the following day, which reporting day does it count toward for SOC 2 point-in-time snapshots?
- Do you produce daily snapshots at a consistent clock time (e.g., 00:00 UTC) or at a job-completion marker?
- For backfilled data (late-arriving telemetry), how do you surface it in the daily manifests and do you include a rollforward/backfill flag?

For audit tracing we need an example manifest row and a short description of how you identify "as-of" vs "ingestion" timestamps, plus any caveats when customers perform same-day edits that straddle midnight.

Could you also confirm whether Redwood will provide a bridge letter that clarifies inclusivity of days for the requested audit window (2026-06-01 through 2026-11-30) if the auditor needs it? Nimbus prefers EOD defined in UTC for their controls, so please call that out if applicable.

Thanks,
Olivia Park
Senior Auditor, OmniAssurance

Attachment: none

From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Park <audit@omniassurance.com>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 25 Sep 2026 16:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SOC 2: EOD rollover / backfill handling question

Hi Olivia — thanks for the clear questions. Short answers first, then an example manifest excerpt below. Happy to hop on a 20-min call if you prefer.

1) Which reporting day?
   - Redwood counts events for the as-of daily snapshot according to the event ingestion time used by the snapshot job, not user-provided event_time. In our standard hosted setup snapshots are materialized at 00:00 UTC (inclusive of the prior calendar day up to 23:59:59.999 UTC).

2) Snapshot timing vs job completion
   - Snapshots are logically defined as 'as-of 00:00:00 UTC' for the prior day. The materialization job runs in a short window after 00:00 UTC; if backfill/late ingestion arrives after the materialization job completes it is recorded in the next snapshot and flagged in the manifest as "backfill".

3) Backfilled data handling and flags
   - We maintain two timestamps per record in our manifests: ingestion_ts (when Redwood observed/received the record) and origin_ts (the customer-supplied event timestamp). Manifests include a field backfill_flag with values: NONE | BACKFILLED | CORRECTED.

Example manifest row (CSV columns):
   record_id, origin_ts, ingestion_ts, snapshot_asof, backfill_flag
   3f9a2b, 2026-09-24T23:58:12Z, 2026-09-25T00:06:04Z, 2026-09-25T00:00:00Z, BACKFILLED

Notes:
- The row above will appear in the 2026-09-25 snapshot (asof 2026-09-25T00:00:00Z) and be marked BACKFILLED because ingestion_ts > snapshot_asof but origin_ts falls in the prior day.
- For controls that strictly require event-time as the determinant, we can provide a supplemental export filtered by origin_ts on request (this is not the default SOC 2 snapshot).

Bridge letter: we can provide a short bridge letter that explicitly states snapshots are defined at 00:00:00 UTC and describes the backfill_flag semantics for the audit window you listed (2026-06-01 to 2026-11-30). We'll attach a draft for your review.

Attachments included: redwood_log_manifest_20260925.csv (sample manifest), snapshot_manifest_20260901-20261130.json (index).

Best,
Mateo Alvarez
Policy & Controls, Redwood Inference

From: Olivia Park <audit@omniassurance.com>

Cc: ops-security@nimbus-analytics.com
Date: Sat, 26 Sep 2026 09:44:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2: EOD rollover / backfill handling question

Thanks, Mateo — that's helpful. A couple of quick clarifications before we finalize the test procedures:

- Timezone: confirm you use UTC for the snapshot_asof in manifests (your example shows Z) — Nimbus will accept UTC but wants the bridge letter to state that explicitly.
- Example coverage: can you provide 2–3 sample rows that illustrate (a) an event where ingestion_ts is before snapshot_asof, (b) one where ingestion_ts is after snapshot_asof and marked BACKFILLED, and (c) a corrected event (CORRECTED)?
- Evidence delivery: Nimbus requires the manifests and the bridge letter uploaded to a shared Drive folder and the bridge letter signed (DocuSign) before fieldwork. Can you provide a DocuSign envelope or a HubSpot/contract reference?

Also — regarding edits: if a customer updates an existing record with a later origin_ts but the record id remains the same, do you surface that as CORRECTED with a correction_reason field? If so, what metadata is preserved for auditors?

If you can send the sample rows and the bridge letter draft, we'll route to Nimbus compliance and schedule the evidence upload.

--Olivia

Hi Olivia — quick follow-up with the requested artifacts and clarifications. See inline and attached.

- UTC confirmation: yes — snapshot_asof is always recorded in UTC (RFC3339 with Z). We'll state that plainly in the draft bridge letter.

- Sample rows (CSV):
   record_id, origin_ts, ingestion_ts, snapshot_asof, backfill_flag, correction_reason
   a1b2c3, 2026-09-24T11:10:05Z, 2026-09-24T11:10:08Z, 2026-09-25T00:00:00Z, NONE, 
   d4e5f6, 2026-09-24T23:58:12Z, 2026-09-25T00:06:04Z, 2026-09-25T00:00:00Z, BACKFILLED, late ingestion
   g7h8i9, 2026-09-23T15:02:01Z, 2026-09-25T02:12:33Z, 2026-09-25T00:00:00Z, CORRECTED, user-corrected-origin_ts

   - CORRECTED rows include correction_reason and a corrected_by (service_user_id) field in the full manifest export.

- Evidence delivery: attached is the draft_bridge_letter_nimbus_20260925.docx. We've uploaded the full evidence bundle to the shared Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB-Redwood-AuditEvidence.

- DocuSign: we've created an envelope to sign the bridge letter. You should see envelope ID ABCD-1234-ENVELOPE at https://docusign.com/envelope/status/ABCD-1234-ENVELOPE. If you prefer we can also provide a PDF for Nimbus to sign offline.

If that all looks good I'll mark the evidence folder as ready for Nimbus and set a retention window for the manifests to match the audit period. Let me know if you want a short recording/screenshare that demonstrates how manifests are generated.

Thanks,
Mateo Alvarez
Policy & Controls, Redwood Inference
